name: Perry
source:
Based on Matthew Calbraith Perry, who was a Commodore of the United States Navy and commanded a number of ships. He served in several wars, most notably in the Mexican–American War and the War of 1812.

"There's no way there's anything of value on an island like this."

An american hero who refers to [url=/c5169]Columbus[/url] as the president.
